title.ja: LBM Taylor–Green渦：格子・刻み・Machの結合感度
title.en: LBM Taylor–Green vortex: coupled grid/time/Mach sensitivity

summary.ja: 周期2Dの非線形渦を実際に時間発展し、連続解析場への速度・圧力・エネルギー誤差を保存します。amplitude感度と同格子のcoupled刻み感度も分けて示します。
summary.en: Evolve a nonlinear periodic2D vortex and save velocity/pressure/energy errors against the continuous analytic field. Distinguish amplitude probes from a fixed-grid coupled-step probe.

assumptions.ja: [0,2pi)²、ν.1、基本U.2、N16/32/64、dt=.2dx²、tau.56、T=.2pi²、64/256/1024steps。N32/U.4,.8とN32/U.2/dt=.1dx²/tau.53/512stepsを追加。初期圧力整合rhoを使用。

algorithm.ja: 標準BGKと完全周期streaming。p=cs²(rho−平均rho)(dx/dt)²で圧力単位とゲージを揃えます。解析場は初期値以外に注入せず、微分を独立Fourier演算で資格確認します。
algorithm.en: Standard BGK and fully periodic streaming. Convert/gauge pressure ascs²(rho−meanrho)(dx/dt)². No analytic field injection after initialization; independently qualify the continuum field by Fourier differentiation.

validation.ja: 22pytestと79判定、6固定発展。最細速度相対L2.03、圧力.08、combined速度次数1.5以上、エネルギー.03、発散・周期質量・平均運動量を判定。解析PDE5資格を区別して保存します。
validation.en: 22pytest and79gates,sixfixed evolutions. Require finest velocity relativeL2.03,pressure.08,combined velocity order≥1.5,energy.03anddivergence/periodic mass/mean momentum. Save five analyticPDEqualifiers distinctly.

limits.ja: 拡散尺度では格子・時間・Machが結合し、amplitude変更はReも変えます。純空間/純時間/純Mach次数や有限Machの厳密非圧縮性を主張しません。平衡初期化のkinetic startupも実誤差へ含めます。
limits.en: Diffusive scaling couples grid,time andMach; amplitude changesRe. No isolated spatial/time/Mach order or exact incompressibility atfiniteMach. Kinetic equilibrium-startup transients remain part of the measured errors.

references.author: Qisu Zou and Xiaoyi He
references.title: On pressure and velocity flow boundary conditions and bounceback for the lattice Boltzmann BGK model
references.review_scope: Selected original preprint pp2-7: standard equilibrium, moment-based flat velocity/density boundaries and corner/finite-Mach limitations. No full-paper audit; special d2q9i accuracy is not credited to this standard BGK.

review.ja: 原著preprintの式と平面流入出境界・角・圧縮性の範囲を選択読解。特殊d2q9iの成功を本BGKへ流用しません。
review.en: Selected primary equations and flat-boundary/corner/compressibility discussion read; special d2q9i successes are not borrowed.

references.author: Pierre Lallemand and Li-Shi Luo
references.title: Lattice Boltzmann method for moving boundaries
references.review_scope: Original article sec3 printed410-414 via author-content mirror; quadratic interpolation paths, q=.5, wall correction, momentum exchange and compromised mass conservation. Our two-point linear implementation is separately derived and qualified; original2001BFL full text was inaccessible.

review.ja: 原著の選択部分を著者資料ミラーから読解。今回の2点線形補間は別導出・単step資格で確認し、2001原著全文を読んだとはしません。
review.en: Selected primary section via author-content mirror. The implemented two-point interpolation is separately derived/qualified; no2001full-text claim.

formulas: u=U\sin x\cos y\,e^{-2\nu t},\quad v=-U\cos x\sin y\,e^{-2\nu t}
